correctness.rationale: Independently verified the translated vector field and the exact derivative of V=[(x-ap)^2+(y+p)^2]/2+z-p-p log(z/p): Vprime=a(y+p)^2-(c-ap)(z-p)^2/z under ap^2-cp+b=0. For a<=0 the equilibrium polynomial is strictly decreasing on p>=0, hence unique p>0 and c-ap>0. z solves a positive integrating-factor equation, so z0>=0 enters or remains in z>0. Properness of V on z>0 (blow-up for z→0+, z→infinity, and x/y infinity) gives global existence. LaSalle zero-derivative invariant set is E: at a=0 derivative vanishes on z=p but zdot=p*x enforces x=0 then xdot=-y-p forces y=-p, so equality boundary is handled. Integrating Vprime yields exact finite initial budget as t→∞; compact two-sided invariant K can have max V only at E by backward recurrence, and a stationary measure must be supported on E by integrating derivative and invariance.

value.rationale: The nonpositive feedback half-space including a=0 is a natural damping boundary of one of the best studied chaotic ODEs. The exact nonlinear logarithmic energy and global basin classification eliminate all nontrivial compact recurrent dynamics and give an energy budget for every initial state, a meaningful structural contrast to classical positive-a chaos.

limitations: No claim for negative initial z, positive a, degenerate b/c, or uniform rates.
Exact total dissipation integral assumes strictly positive initial height; z0=0 enters positivity immediately.
